description: Consumo de gas natural is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Foral de Navarra. The natural gas consumption statistic provides information on natural gas consumption in gigawatt hours (GWh) per pressure group in Navarre and Spain. Coverage: Comunidad Foral de Navarra. The portal shows the English title as "Natural gas consumption" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Foral de Navarra. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2026-06-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
